newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: St George says nears securitised issue.
newsitem.headline: St George says nears securitised issue.

text.p: St George Bank Ltd said on Wednesday that it is close to announcing a securitised mortgage bond issue of about A$500 million.
"St George will do a securitisation very soon," managing director Jim Sweeney told Reuters.
"It will be in the area of half a billion dollars. There are still a few things to be done to tie it up systems-wise and legal-wise but we are very close."

The bank, Australia's fifth largest with about 70 percent of its loan book tied to mortgages, said earlier this year that it would announce a securitisation of this scale sometime in the second half of calendar 1997.
